critique: The note proves the published-model tangent exhaustion, canonical gradient, and attaining estimator only for fixed finite-support covariates at conditional-mean interior laws with separated fixed-law ranks; for arbitrary covariate support it proves only the full-data/observed-law image. Thus the broad conditional-efficiency objective remains unresolved for continuous covariates, and inference is merely pointwise rather than valid near equality or rank-changing boundaries. The advertised CRAN triplediff integration is explicitly future work, so the delivered package contains neither that implementation nor supporting computational evidence. The framing accurately distinguishes the canonical OVS projection from the weaker aggregate loading optimum, but the discrete-support scope, nonuniform inference, and missing implementation keep the projected leading-journal score below the strongest field-level benchmarks.
